proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_on_hit_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is a weapon-hit rider, but MagicItemRecord only supports passive grants or activated abilities. It needs an on-hit trigger family analogous to mastery-side on_hit_trigger.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage...

proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.fixed
proposed_widenings.justification: The save uses a fixed item DC 15, which is not representable by caster spell save DC, weapon attack DC, or innate DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw...

proposed_widenings.name: block_hp_regain
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect prevents a target from regaining hit points for a duration. Existing atoms cover healing, max-HP changes, and healing maximization, but not a healing-prevention lockout.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...or be unable to regain Hit Points for 1 hour.

notes: No content/tracer files were authored. The primary blocker is structural: current magic-item mechanics cannot express weapon-hit riders honestly. Even with that family added, the unit still needs a fixed save DC source and an atom for preventing HP regain. The repeat-save tail itself would fit once those gaps are addressed.
